name: openssl
description: OpenSSL is an open source project that provides a robust, commercial-grade, and full-featured toolkit for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocols. It is also a general-purpose cryptography library. Why an overlay exists: the library's C code has to be compiled by the same compiler as Node.js. On Windows that is clang-cl (vcbuild.bat forces it for Node.js >= 24), while vcpkg builds ports with cl.exe, and the two differ in what they emit for arm64: with cl.exe-built OpenSSL the arm64 Windows suite crashed in 250 silent TLS cases, and with clang-cl-built OpenSSL - everything else unchanged - it passes completely (issue #22). The overlay therefore points the OpenSSL build at clang-cl. Nothing else about the port changes: same version, same options, same install layout. port-version 2 records that this is the baseline's build with its compiler changed, not a newer upstream release.
